<RecipeSection label="Problem">

Half your helpdesk tickets are "how do I reset my SSO password" and "how do I get a new laptop." Your IT docs already answer both. You want a page that answers them before a ticket gets filed, without pulling an engineer off other work to build it.

</RecipeSection>

<TakeItFurther>

- Scope the `CHAT` token even further if your Glean plan supports per-collection tokens, so this tool can only ever answer from IT content.
- Compare this to [`no-code-pto-lookup-replit`](/cookbook/no-code-pto-lookup-replit). Same Chat API call, same constraint that the browser never holds the token, different no-code tool and persona.
- Once your team outgrows the no-code version, [`company-answers`](/cookbook/company-answers) shows the same pattern as a hand-written, version-controlled app.

</TakeItFurther>
